name: shopify-product-image-browser
description: A single-file HTML tool for browsing and filtering product images from any public Shopify storefront — no server or build step required
summary: Lets you browse and filter product images from any public Shopify store without needing special software. Marketing and product teams can quickly find specific products by type or name and see all related images in one place, saving time compared to manually searching through the store. It works entirely in the browser and shows results as they load, making image review faster and easier.
